## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9777ca9789e8096277a4359388b140e3afb95dd9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md + none

Inputs read: card #31743 (body; comments 6730406849, 6731133116, 6739066323 ruling A, 6739111269, 6739159874 claim with the seat's LOCK pick, 6739424761 dev report); PR #31917 body and file list (one file, +106/−2); the net diff `origin/main...9777ca97` (merge-base `6a8f4151`); the 48 check-runs on the head. Code cited by the amendment was read on `origin/main` at `6a8f4151`, never reviewed. Line numbers below are the ADR's at the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept-set changes in the tree.** The diff is ADR prose; no schema, code, test or changeset moves. Right.
- **Two declared future admissions, each matching ruling A and nothing wider** (D2 note L201-209, D6 note L282-294, Status L3): (a) a two-segment `currencyField` whose first segment is a `master_detail` field of the amount's own object and whose second names a `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'` text field on that field's target, `master_detail` only, a `lookup` path refused, one-segment form unchanged for every other amount; (b) a `summary` admitted only when it rolls up through that very `master_detail`, every other roll-up and every other aggregate (ObjectQL aggregate, dataset and cube measures) keeping D6's first bullet. The spec's `summaryOperations.relationshipField` (auto-detected from the child's `master_detail` or `lookup`, `field.zod.ts` L2177) makes "the master_detail the summary rolls up through" a definite thing, so (b) is checkable at registration. Right; neither narrower nor wider than 6739066323.
- **One declared future refusal, the LOCK** (D2 note L211-234): an update that changes a parent's code field, to another code or to blank, is refused while at least one child row follows it; `VALIDATION_FAILED` / 400, one `invalid_value` finding on the code field, read per write, never recorded, lifts when no child follows, same-code rewrite and blank-to-code pass; cascade named as not chosen with the seat's three reasons quoted exactly as claim 6739159874 has them. Right against the seat's ruling, and consistent with D4 (lock on use, lifts by itself, first setting of an unset value passes: `localization-currency-lock.ts` header, Open item 4 note L531-534) and D5 (stored rows change only through an explicit recompute). The envelope attribution has one nit (N1).
- **Ruled text untouched.** D1's quote (L182-185), D2's bullets (L196-199), D6's bullets (L275-280) and every other ruled sentence are byte-identical to `main`; the two removed lines are the Status line and one Provenance sentence, each re-emitted with an appended note. Notes are dated, use this record's own `*Note (DATE):*` / `*Amended (DATE, #N):*` inline form and ADR-0048's blockquote form (`0048` L310), and the Status keyword stays `Accepted` with an `**Amended**` entry, the shape `scripts/adr-index.mjs` parses (`check:adr-index` green). Right.
- **Cited sites exist in the live tree as described** (Execution block L296-308): `field.zod.ts#refuseRecordModeKeyMismatch` L549 requires `currencyField` under `record`; `object.zod.ts#refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField` L1934 refuses a pointer naming no same-object code field (`declared = target !== name && hasOwnProperty(map, target)`, so a dotted path is refused today); `object.zod.ts#refuseDishonestHomeAmount` L2053 compares the code pointers of amounts sharing a `rateField` (its docblock, the `rateOwner` map); `record-currency-code.ts#recordCurrencyFieldOf` L58 returns the raw string, read by `home-amount-projection.ts` L116, `record-currency-backfill.ts` L260 and `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` L108/219/228; `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts#recordCurrencySummaryRefusal` L205 refuses in both registration orders, called from `registry.ts` L5141. Right (one omission, N4).
- **Public surface:** none published; `docs/adr/**` is Tier H prose. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the one file is `docs/adr/**`, no package publishes anything, no consumer's accept set moves until #31910, #31911 and #31912 land with their own changesets (the amendment says so at L3 and L435). `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right: nothing is widened or narrowed in code. `Check Changeset` success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev open question, the two readings beyond the ruling's words.** Answer: **A, keep both as written**, and neither needs a fresh maintainer ruling; the maintainer's Tier H approval of this amendment is the act that seats them, as it seats the LOCK pick itself.
  1. *The first setting of a blank parent code passes the lock* (L229-232). Supported: D4's lock passes the first setting of an unset value "nothing has been converted into a currency that does not exist" (Open item 4 note L531-534; `localization-currency-lock.ts` header), and the amendment's own premise 2 makes the analogy hold: with a blank parent code no child amount has been stored or converted. It is a refinement of the seat's pick, inside the delegation the ruling made ("picks one of these two, in the amendment itself"). Coherent with reasons 1-3 (nothing to re-rate, nothing to fan out).
  2. *A child amount beside a blank parent code meets `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` at its own write* (L231). Supported: Open items 9 and 13 define that code as "a `record`-mode amount beside a blank code"; `record-currency-code.ts` header judges a pair "when its amount holds a value and its code field is blank", and `projectHomeAmounts` leaves a blank-code entry to that refusal (L347-348). Once the amount's code field is the parent's, the rule applies unchanged. Implementation detail for #31911, not for this record: the finding's `field` today "names the code field to fill" on the written row; for a parent-held code the remedy is on another record, so #31911 settles what `field` carries.
  Advice outside ④: the PR body's 维护者速读 names the lock for confirmation but not reading 1; one line there would let the maintainer approve it knowingly. Not judged here.
- **Dev deviation 1** (claim wording over brief wording for reason 1): right, the claim is the record of record and the three reasons are quoted exactly.
- **Dev deviation 2** (extra symbol anchors): right, every added anchor verified above.
- **Dev deviation 3** (Open item 14, D1 note): judged in ④ (S2, S3, N3).
- **Escalated, out of scope for this PR:** re-pointing an existing `currencyField` on an object that holds rows (sibling to sibling today, sibling to parent path after #31910) is unjudged: the 409 `destructive_change` finding `currency_mode_to_record` (`protocol-write-face.ts` L250) fires on a mode change only, so stored home amounts converted under the old code field keep their values under a new currency source. A pre-existing ADR-0144 gap this amendment does not open; a follow-up card for `domain:spec`, not a finding on this head.

### ④ Design judgment

`hits` file: `docs/adr/0144-…md`, judged against ruling A (6739066323), the seat's LOCK ruling (6739159874), the rest of ADR-0144, ADR-0148, and the cited code on `main`. No implementing file in the diff.

**Should-fix**

- **S1 · "verbatim" labels a paraphrase** — D2 note L211-214. The ruling's condition is introduced as "verbatim", but record 6739066323 reads: "The amendment must state what happens when a parent record's currency changes after child rows exist. It picks one of these two, in the amendment itself, and does not leave the choice to the objectql child card: the parent's code field locks once it has children; or the children's home-currency projections are rewritten in cascade." The ADR's quote keeps the first sentence and rewrites the rest ("Pick one in the amendment; do not leave it to the objectql child card"). Same meaning, not the record's words. The D6 note L283-284 "verbatim" also drops the record's comma before "and is admitted". This record's Provenance rule is that the ruling's text wins and is quoted "wherever the wording matters"; a mislabelled quote in a Tier H ruled record is a provenance defect. Fix: quote the record's sentences as written, or drop "verbatim" and say "the condition, as recorded". Prose face only.
- **S2 · the lock's lift is breakable through the recycle bin** — D2 note L228-229 ("the lock lifts once the last following child row is gone") and Open item 14 L646-655. A child deleted on its own goes to the recycle bin (ADR-0148; a cascaded child goes with its master). If "follows" counts live rows only, the parent's code can change while the child is binned; a restore then writes the row raw through the driver, with no insert hook and no projection (`packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/restore.ts` header, "Why raw"; ADR-0148 D2), so the restored child carries a home amount and rate converted under the old code and now displays under the new one: the relabel-without-re-rate the lock exists to prevent (seat reason 1). The amendment neither counts binned children as following nor names the edge. Fix, either: one clause in the D2 note (a child row in the recycle bin follows its parent until purged, so the lock reads the bin too, or a restore under a changed parent code is a refusal of ADR-0148's "never forces a write" kind), or a fourth bullet in Open item 14 handing it to #31911 with ADR-0148 named. Prose face only.
- **S3 · Open item 14 edge 2 assigns a widening to a child card's review** — L651-653, with D6 note L292-294. The item asks whether an ObjectQL aggregate or a dataset or cube measure "that groups by the `master_detail` field, or by the parent path, counts as grouped by its code field". Grouping by the two-segment path is D6's first bullet as amended (that path is now the amount's code field). Grouping by the `master_detail` field itself is single-currency by construction but is not grouping by the code field; admitting it widens D6 past ruling A, which admits `summary` only. The Open-items header says each item "is settled under that card's review", so as written a child's review could settle a widening the triage rule (#31424 rule 2) reserves for a ruling; items 12 and 13 named the authority when they had this shape. Fix: one clause saying the parent-path half is D6 as amended and the `master_detail`-field half takes a maintainer ruling, escalated from #31911's review. Prose face only.

**Nit**

- **N1 · envelope attribution** — L224-227. "That is the vocabulary D4's lock answers in" is true of the finding code only: D4's lock answers through `SettingsValidationError`, whose top-level `code` is `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` (`settings-service.types.ts` L884), carrying ADR-0114 `FieldError` entries with `code: 'invalid_value'` (`settings-service.ts` L3349). `VALIDATION_FAILED` is the record-write path's own envelope (Open item 9, `settleBulkHomeAmounts`). The prescription for the new lock is right; the sentence should say the shared part is the `invalid_value` finding.
- **N2 · summary faces overstate the lock** — Status L3, TL;DR L47-48, Consequences L433. "refused on update while such a child exists" omits what D2 passes (same code again, blank to code). Acceptable as a summary pointing at D2; one word ("a change to") would align them.
- **N3 · Open item 14 edge 1 decides while saying it does not** — L648-650. "Such a move changes the child's currency the way a write of its own code field changes a sibling-code amount's currency today" is an assertion inside a list headed "do not decide". Either quote it as a lean (the header's convention) or move it into the D2 note as decided; it needs no maintainer ruling, since a reparent is a child-row write the existing per-row projection already covers.
- **N4 · reader list incomplete** — L303-306. `recordCurrencyFieldOf`'s readers also include `recordCurrencyPairs` in the same file (the `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` guard), which #31911 must re-point for premise 2 of the blank-code reading to hold. Add it.

**Held against the design, no finding:** ruling fidelity on both admissions; `master_detail` only; two-segment only (a grandparent chain is excluded because the second segment must be a code field, not an amount); LOCK stated once, refusal named, D4's lock cited as precedent and matched on lock-on-use, read-per-write and first-setting; "to blank" covered; the engine-path claim (REST, import, flows, bulk) consistent with `settleBulkHomeAmounts`'s existing per-row `invalid_value`; Open item 14 edge 3 (backfill writes into the amount's own object, `record-currency-backfill.ts` L260) a real gap that is #31911's; the three seat reasons quoted exactly; D1 note quotes two D1 clauses exactly.

**Check-runs on `9777ca97`:** 48, all `completed`; every run that ran is `success` (Lint & Repo Gates and its seven shards, TypeScript Type Check and its four shards, Test Core and its planner shard, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Auto Label, filter); the rest are `skipped` by path filter (UI build and shards, Build Docs, Temporal Conformance, opt-in harnesses, queue verdicts). No failure, no neutral, nothing in progress.

Reviewed-by: `fable-subagent of session_01QsR2jUe9c6YdtNkrzUnMUd`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Three should-fixes (S1, S2, S3), four nits; no must-fix. The should-fixes are prose on the `hits` face and earn a delta review of their fix on the new head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `809f177463cf9aa577d2938cba7a2fd15923f5f9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md + none

Inputs read: the prior record [`6739836182`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/31917#issuecomment-6739836182) on head `9777ca97` (PASS, should-fixes S1–S3, nits N1–N4); the fix commit `809f1774` as the net diff `9777ca97..809f1774` (one file, +35/−20); the whole-PR diff against `origin/main` `6a8f4151` (+121/−2) to re-check the ruled text; PR #31917 body v2; the check-runs on `809f1774`; record 6739066323 re-read for the exact wording; ADR-0148 D2 and `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/restore.ts` on `main`. **This is a delta covering the fix commit only.** Everything the prior record judged and the fix did not touch stands as judged there. Line numbers are the ADR's at `809f1774`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept-set or public-surface change in the tree.** Still ADR prose; no code, schema, test or changeset. Right.
- **Ruled text still byte-identical to `main`.** The whole-PR diff removes exactly the same two lines as before, the Status line (L3) and one Provenance sentence (L76), each re-emitted with its note appended; D1's quote, D2's bullets, D6's bullets and every other ruled sentence are unchanged. Right.
- **The lock's declared shape is unchanged in substance** and now stated the same way on every face (Status L3, TL;DR L47-49, D2 note, Consequences L445-446): a change of the parent's code field is refused while a child follows, the same code again and a first code over a blank one pass. The one addition is S2's: a child row in the recycle bin still follows (D2 note L235-240). Right against the seat's LOCK ruling, see ④.
- **The two admissions are untouched** (D2 note L201-210, D6 note L293-305). Right, as before.
- **New symbol anchor** `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts#recordCurrencyPairs` (L315-316) exists on `main` at L69. Right.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset` right, `Clause-②: no` right; `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing. `Check Changeset` on the head is path-skipped and the PR-body guards are `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR body v2.** The 维护者速读 now names the binned-child rule and the blank-first-setting pass for the maintainer's confirmation, the advice the prior record gave outside ④. The body's account of the fixes matches the tree.
- **No new dev flag and no new open question.** The two readings the prior record kept (blank first setting passes; blank parent code refuses the child amount) are unchanged in the tree.
- **Still escalated, out of scope:** re-pointing an existing `currencyField` on an object with rows (prior record ③). Not touched by the fix, not owed by it.

### ④ Design judgment

Each prior finding against the fix commit:

- **S1 · fixed.** D2 note L212-219 now reads "The record of the ruling states its condition, verbatim:" and quotes record 6739066323 to the character, the two options carried as quoted bullets ("the parent's code field locks once it has children; or" / "the children's home-currency projections are rewritten in cascade."). D6 note L294-295 now quotes "A `summary` rolled up through that same master_detail is single-currency by construction, and is admitted in the parent's currency." with the record's comma and capital. Both compared against the record's body as served by the API. Closed.
- **S2 · fixed, and coherent.** D2 note L235-240: a child row in the recycle bin still follows its parent, the lock counts it until the row is restored or purged, a restore writes the snapshot back with no projection, and refusing the restore is named as not chosen because the child stores no code and its snapshot carries none to compare against. Judged:
  - *Against ADR-0148 D2:* the citation is accurate. D2 says a restore "writes the snapshotted rows back under their original ids … emits its own `restored` event, never a create", and `restore.ts` writes raw through the driver with no insert hook and no projection. A refusal of such a restore would be a fourth entry in D2's refusal list, an ADR-0148 amendment this card does not carry, and the stated reason holds: the snapshot has the amount, the home amount and the rate, never the code they were converted from, so a restore could not tell whether the parent's code moved. Keeping the hazard out by holding the lock instead is the shape that needs no second ADR.
  - *Against the lock lifting:* still coherent. "Follows" is still read at each write and never recorded; "gone" now means neither live nor in the bin, and a purge (ADR-0148 D3's TTL) lifts the lock by itself exactly as a delete did. A cascaded delete takes the parent with its children, so no lock question arises there; ADR-0148 D2 forbids restoring a cascaded child alone, so the only binned-child-under-live-parent case is the row deleted on its own, which is the case the note covers. Reasons 1 and 3 of the seat's ruling hold unchanged: no stored conversion is ever re-rated, and the parent write still fans out to nothing.
  - *Cost named, not hidden:* the lock now reads the recycle-bin store as well as the child tables; that is #31911's and the note points at ADR-0148 for it. Closed.
- **S3 · fixed.** Open item 14 edge 2 (L666-670) now asks only about grouping by the parent path, "the code field reached through the `master_detail`", and calls that half "#31911's reading of D6"; it says grouping by the `master_detail` field itself "would widen D6 past ruling A, so that half takes a maintainer ruling." That is the venue split the prior record asked for. Closed.
- **N1 · fixed.** L229-233: `VALIDATION_FAILED` named as "the record-write envelope"; `invalid_value` named as the finding D4's lock also carries "inside the settings write's own `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` envelope". Matches `SettingsValidationError` (`settings-service.types.ts` L884) and `settings-service.ts` L3349. Closed.
- **N2 · fixed.** Status L3, TL;DR L47-49 and Consequences L445-446 say "a change of … is refused" and name the two passes; Consequences adds "a binned row included", which restates the D2 note. Closed.
- **N3 · fixed.** Edge 1 (L663-665) now carries the reparent behaviour as "The lean, not adopted here: …", the Open-items header's convention. The added clause "and the write projects again" is part of the lean, not a decision. Closed.
- **N4 · fixed.** `recordCurrencyPairs` added to `recordCurrencyFieldOf`'s reader list (L315-316), labelled "the blank-code guard of D8 rule 4". Closed.

**No new claim introduced.** Every changed sentence either quotes the record, restates the D2 note on another face, labels a lean, or names an existing symbol or envelope as the tree has it. The one new decision, the binned child follows, is the resolution of S2 inside the seat's LOCK pick, judged above. Nothing wider than ruling A was admitted and nothing in the ruled text moved.

**No new finding.**

**Check-runs on `809f1774`:** 44 found, none failed, none neutral. At the time of this record 14 are `success` (PR-body guards ×2, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, filter, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Plan Test Core shards), 21 `skipped` by path filter, and 9 still `in_progress`: Test Core (1/8), Type Check · debt ledger, · workspace, · consumer gates, · source gates, Lint · ESLint, · docs & code guards, · repo & tooling gates, · CI, release & engine gates. Their conclusions are the gate verdicts: this PASS stands when they conclude `success`, and a failure among them re-opens the round on that gate alone. The dev's local `dispatch-gates` on this head reports 21/21 exit 0, which this record reads but does not rely on.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 ADR-0144 的文字（一个文件，+121/−2），没有代码改动。按你对 #31743 的裁决 A，写入三条修订：
  - 明细行（master_detail 子对象）的金额可以直接跟随主记录的币种，只限 master_detail，lookup 不行；
  - 沿同一条 master_detail 的汇总（summary）按主记录币种允许，其他聚合仍按 D6 原规则；
  - 主记录一旦有跟随它的明细行，它的币种字段就锁定，回收站里的明细也算。原本为空的币种第一次填写不受锁定，再写同一个币种也不算修改。
- 为什么改：执行你 2026-11-09 的裁决 A（「同意」），附带条件是修订本身要在“锁定”和“级联重算”之间二选一。席位选了锁定，理由有三：D5 在写入时就存下汇率；D4 对本位币也用同样的锁；级联重算会无限制地扩散写入。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字，没有运行时风险，也不发版（`skip-changeset`）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。真正的行为变化由三张子卡实现，它们都被本卡阻塞：#31910（spec）、#31911（objectql）、#31912（ui）。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0144-…md` 中 D2 下的 2026-11-09 修订注（锁定条款、拒绝方式、回收站明细、空币种首次填写放行），D6 下的修订注（汇总的允许边界），以及 Open item 14（留给子卡的三个边界情况）。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `git grep -n "Amended (2026-11-09, #31743)" -- docs/adr/`，应命中 5 处（席位已在本 head 上数过，确为 5 处）；再运行 `pnpm check:adr-index`，应为绿。
- 需要你做的：确认“锁定”这个选择（包括“空币种首次填写放行”和“回收站明细也算跟随”这两条），然后批准本 PR（Tier H，改了 `docs/adr/**`）。批准后由本席落地。契约复核 PASS 在案：增量记录是评论 6740075527，`Head-sha: 809f177463cf9aa577d2938cba7a2fd15923f5f9`，承接 9777ca97 上的首份记录 6739836182。
- 席位意见：建议合。CI 全绿。首份契约复核提出的三条应改项和四条 nit 已全部在 809f1774 上改好，增量复核通过，没有新的发现。这份修订只承诺未来的行为，三张子卡落地前，运行时什么都不变。
